overviewDescription: Review learning activity, support tickets, and teacher request signals.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Invite or assign accounts, reset passwords, and move accounts through their lifecycle. Accounts are never deleted.
accounts.dateOfBirthHint: Optional. Determines whether the account counts as a minor.
accounts.reasonPrompt: Reason for this change (recorded in the audit log)
accounts.inviteNotDelivered: Account {{accountNumber}} was created, but the email was not delivered. Pass the link on yourself or resend it.
accounts.inviteFailed: The invitation could not be created.
accounts.assignFailed: The account could not be created.
accounts.reissueFailed: The invitation could not be reissued.
accounts.passwordReset: Password reset. The account must choose a new one at the next sign-in.
accounts.passwordResetFailed: The password could not be reset.
accounts.statusFailed: The status could not be changed.
accounts.loadFailed: The account list could not be loaded.
accounts.reasonRequired: Enter a reason first: every account change is recorded.

errors.account_peer_admin_password_reset_forbid: An administrator cannot reset another administrator's password. That account has to be reset from AWS.
errors.account_last_active_admin: This is the only administrator still active. Activate another one before changing this account.
errors.account_self_deactivation_forbidden: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.account_state_invalid: This account is not in a state that allows the change.
errors.invitation_not_reissuable: This invitation was already replaced or revoked. Send a new one.
errors.date_of_birth_invalid: That date of birth is not a valid past date. Use the day, month and year of birth.

activation.title: Activate your account
activation.body: This invitation opens your STOA account. Choose a password, then sign in.
activation.dateOfBirthHint: Optional. Leave empty if your school has already recorded it.
activation.success: Your account is active. Sign in to get started.
activation.missingToken: This invitation link is missing a token. Open the link from your email.
activation.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
activation.failed: We could not activate this invitation. Please try again.

errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask an administrator to send a new one.
errors.auth_request_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.account_exists: An account already exists for this email. Sign in instead.
errors.password_rejected: This password was rejected. Choose a stronger password.
errors.date_of_birth_invalid: That date of birth is not a valid past date. Use the day, month and year of birth.
